title: New Dayton office opens Tuesday, July 2nd
seoTitle: New Dayton office opens Tuesday, July 2nd
metaDescription: JourneyLite opens its Dayton location on Tuesday, July 2, 2012. Accepting new and follow-up patients for Lap Band, sleeve gastrectomy, gastric bypass – call today.
excerpt: JourneyLite opens its Dayton location on Tuesday, July 2, 2012. Accepting new and follow-up patients for Lap Band, sleeve gastrectomy, gastric bypass – call today.
author: DrCurry
bodyHtml: We are happy to announce that our Dayton office is opening this Tuesday!  We will be seeing new and followup surgical weight loss patients for Lap Band, Sleeve Gastrectomy, Gastric Plication, and Gastric Bypass.  We will also be doing new and follow-up Adipex and HCG diet evaluations. For more info, call 937-280-LOSE.  The address of the new clinic is 1222 S. Patterson Blvd, less than a mile off of exit 51 from I-75. Google Map Trace Curry MD
